summary: No unresolved security defects remain. The default GITHUB_TOKEN has no permissions, actions are SHA-pinned, the installation token is scoped to the current repository and three required permissions, immutable releases are enabled, and the live main rulesets require fresh human approval with no bypass actors.
limitations: The reviewer token cannot inspect the GitHub App installation's configured repository selection or granted permissions through the installation API, so those settings remain an operational verification item.
The App-backed release workflow cannot run end to end until this PR is merged and a push reaches main.
